rules.public way: what is not a county parcel (2025)
rules.roadway: public way further than 362 cm from a parcel, corners rounded at 300 cm; the distance is the 1st percentile measured on the earlier parts' roadway on Wieland
rules.alley: public way narrower than 760 cm: paved wall to wall, no kerb, and through the sidewalk at its mouth
rules.lawn: the 2025 photograph shows plants (near infrared against red above 0.35) and the 2022 laser scan shows them lower than 0.6 m; strips narrower than 150 cm and patches under 4 m2 are dropped (rings at the edge of tree crowns)
rules.tree pits and beds in the sidewalk: taken from the earlier parts' own ground where they have it
rules.car park: a parcel over 300 m2 of which under 5 percent is building, and the earlier parts' asphalt
rules.private paving: everything else inside a parcel that is not building
